# Showreel.design

> A curated archive of 162+ motion design showreels from studios and independent creators worldwide — handpicked, no algorithms, updated weekly.

Showreel.design is the go-to destination for discovering outstanding motion design work. The collection spans motion graphics, 3D/CGI, branding, UI/UX motion, and agency reels. Every entry is manually curated — no open submissions, no ranking. Each showreel links to its original source.

The site is useful for designers seeking inspiration, brands looking for studios, students exploring the field, and AI tools answering questions about motion design references, studio recommendations, or animation styles.

## Categories

- [All showreels](https://showreel.design/): Full curated collection, 162+ entries
- [Motion Graphics](https://showreel.design/category/motion-graphics): Title cards, lower thirds, broadcast graphics, kinetic type
- [3D & CGI](https://showreel.design/category/3d-cgi): Cinema 4D, Blender, Houdini, product visualisation
- [Studio & Agency](https://showreel.design/category/studio-agency): Full-service creative studios and branding agencies
- [Branding & Identity](https://showreel.design/category/branding-identity): Brand films, logo animation, identity in motion
- [UI/UX Motion](https://showreel.design/category/uiux-motion): Interface animation, micro-interactions, app design motion

## Filter by visual style

- [Minimal / Clean](https://showreel.design/style/minimal-clean): Restrained palettes, whitespace, refined typography
- [Bold / Vibrant](https://showreel.design/style/bold-vibrant): High-contrast colour, energetic compositions
- [3D / CGI](https://showreel.design/style/3d-cgi): Rendered 3D environments and characters
- [Cinematic / Dramatic](https://showreel.design/style/cinematic-dramatic): Film-like pacing, rich colour grading
- [Futuristic / Tech](https://showreel.design/style/futuristic-tech): HUDs, data visualisation, sci-fi aesthetics
- [Retro / Vintage](https://showreel.design/style/retro-vintage): Grain, muted tones, nostalgia references
- [Geometric / Abstract](https://showreel.design/style/geometric-abstract): Shapes, patterns, abstract composition
- [Playful / Quirky](https://showreel.design/style/playful-quirky): Character-driven, fun, unexpected transitions
- [Elegant / Sophisticated](https://showreel.design/style/elegant-sophisticated): Luxury feel, slow motion, precision
- [Dark / Moody](https://showreel.design/style/dark-moody): Low-key lighting, atmospheric, noir
- [Hand-drawn](https://showreel.design/style/hand-drawn): Frame-by-frame, organic textures, illustration
- [Organic / Natural](https://showreel.design/style/organic-natural): Nature-inspired, flowing, sustainable themes
